hook.first_second_description: Phone face-up on desk; ring + after-hours clock overlay; no logo
hook.spoken: It's 9:14. Your phone rings. Nobody picks up.

shots.subject: phone ringing
shots.recipe: phone face-up, practical lamp depth, handheld micro-shake, real desk clutter, no logo
empty bay/desk, window or practical light, different camera setup than shot 0

shots.subject: call UI idle→answered
shots.recipe: flat UI documentary ≥70% frame; hard cut from place setup

shots.subject: book/transfer confirm
shots.recipe: UI confirm state, same ortho setup, hard cut
endcard safe-zone; phone/CTA large; bed under

audio.music: licensed bed only — no sine placeholder
audio.sfx: real ring into silence then soft UI click

look.grade: cool documentary desk + flat product UI
look.typography: Anton hook ≤6 words; Inter Tight captions
look.avoid: neon AI brain, kids-app mascot in cold open

offer_and_proof.offer: after-hours / overflow answer → book or transfer
offer_and_proof.proof: [PLACEHOLDER: needs user proof] — never invent call counts

why_it_works: Makes the missed call expensive before brand; mechanism (answer→book) is the proof. Full cut required — void alone is not the ad.
steal: Void vs answered split with hard cuts
Flat UI documentary for the product beat
Single CTA held ≥3s in safe zone
Cut between photographed setups — not one canvas with new words
Room tone + licensed bed under VO
what_not_to_copy: Competitor scripts, logos, mascots, or UI chrome
materials_ceiling: hybrid_gen_plus_stock until real phone/van/hands footage is ledgered — designed cards alone fail FB/TikTok look test
